message.reasoning:
The user is playing Monopoly and must choose between mortgaging property or declaring bankruptcy to cover a $750 rent shortfall.

Mortgaging any single property yields only $130–$140. That falls $100 short of the $243 shortfall, so one mortgage will not cover the rent.

The engine only allows one liquidation action per turn. I will mortgage one property now and be asked again if the shortfall remains. All three options are part of the same yellow monopoly, so mortgaging any one breaks the ability to build until unmortgaged.

Mortgaging Marvin Gardens first yields the highest cash return. The next turn I will mortgage one of the remaining yellow properties.

I will mortgage Atlantic Avenue and Ventnor Avenue, keeping Marvin Gardens unmortgaged. Unmortgaged properties still collect base rent, and Marvin Gardens yields $24 compared to $22 for the others.
